rationale: The dataset identifies the managed Red Hat OpenShift-on-IBM-Cloud container platform. IBM's product page documents managed OpenShift, security, provisioning/lifecycle management and observability, all conventional deployment/platform operations. IBM AI offerings elsewhere are not evidence that this service includes AI.
version_scope: Unversioned dataset offering; official current IBM page is specific to Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud; historical release not specified.

sources.excerpt: Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud is a fully managed OpenShift cloud service designed with built-in security ... The service is highly available ... Identity and access management ... Schematics for provisioning and life cycle management ... Observability
sources.applicability: Officially documents the named managed OpenShift service and conventional operations relevant to the record; not IBM's separate AI products.
